# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a bright and vivid young woman with black eyes. In her second year at Queen's Academy, she was considered the most beautiful girl in her class.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella is sympathetic, bright, and full of whimsical, rainbow-like dreams and fancies. She possesses a playful and mischievous spirit, though she takes things seriously when needed and can speak plainly to her friends. She is also given to occasional moods of discouragement or brain fag when overwhelmed by study.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c35 P32](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0032)_

- Bright and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Imaginative and dreamful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Direct and plain-spoken  <sub>[v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c25 P24](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0024)</sub>

- Scholastic ability  <sub>[v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- Teaching  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To pursue higher education and graduate with good honors at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, where she stood out as one of the most attractive and imaginative students. After graduating from Queen's, she spent several years teaching school before deciding to continue her education at Redmond College. Prior to her arrival at Redmond, Stella proposed that she, Anne, Priscilla, and her aunt set up a shared home, leading them to rent Patty's Place. During their time at Patty's Place, Stella managed the household accounts and spent her final college years diligently studying for her degree. After achieving a good all-round standing at graduation, Stella eventually moved to Vancouver to teach.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c17 P1](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0001), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)_
